methods.label: Compare signs and absolute values
methods.explanation: Negative numbers are less than \(0\), and \(0\) is less than positive numbers. Of two negative numbers, the one with the greater absolute value is smaller. Since \(|-5|>|-1|\), \(-5\) is the smallest.
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 sign, absolute-value, and rational-number comparison rules.
